description: This file defines the LinearBestFit class in the PhpSpreadsheet library, which implements linear regression functionality for trend analysis, including methods to compute the best-fit line, equation, and related values.

classes.name: LinearBestFit
classes.description: A class that calculates and provides properties of a linear best fit line for given data points.

methods.name: getValueOfYForX
methods.description: Calculates the Y value corresponding to a given X value on the best-fit line.

methods.name: getValueOfXForY
methods.description: Calculates the X value corresponding to a given Y value on the best-fit line.

methods.name: getEquation
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the linear equation of the best-fit line.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructs a new LinearBestFit object, performing linear regression on the provided data.
